summary: Renders a GLSL shader into a TOP image. Can run pixel shaders or compute shaders and should be paired with Info DAT or error checks for compile state.

key_params.name: pixelshader
key_params.note: DAT containing the pixel shader source

key_params.name: compute shader
key_params.note: Compute shader source when using compute mode

common_gotchas: Shader compile failures can produce black output; inspect errors or an Info DAT before declaring success.
Sampler names and uniforms must match TouchDesigner's GLSL conventions for TOP inputs.
